description: A React functional component named EntityUsage that renders a detailed dashboard for entity-based metrics including cost, model activity, key activity, provider usage, and top entities. It fetches and processes daily activity data related to different entity types, displays various charts and tables, and integrates several imported utilities and components.

methods.name: getTopModels
methods.description: Processes accumulated data to identify top 5 models by spend.

methods.name: getTopAPIKeys
methods.description: Processes data to get top 5 API keys based on spend and associated metadata.

methods.name: getProviderSpend
methods.description: Accumulates and sorts provider-specific spend and request metrics.

methods.name: getAllTags
methods.description: Returns the provided entity list if available, used for filtering.

methods.name: getEntityLabel
methods.description: Returns display label for an entity, fallback to team alias, or original string.

methods.name: filterDataByTags
methods.description: Filters data based on selected tags.

methods.name: getEntityBreakdown
methods.description: Aggregates spend and request metrics per entity, optionally filtered by tags.

methods.name: getProcessedEntityBreakdownForChart
methods.description: Prepares processed top entities data for chart visualization.

methods.name: getFilterLabel
methods.description: Returns filter label string based on entity type.

methods.name: getFilterPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns placeholder string for filter input.
